items.title: New Research Highlights the Importance of Exploring Treatment Options Before Tooth Loss
items.summary: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE Study published in the Journal of Endodontics suggests many cracked teeth can be successfully treated and preserved CHICAGO — A diagnosis of a cracked tooth can leave patients fearing the worst.
